source.title: Eryndor - Veiled Viceroy
source.name: Eryndor
source.description: A mage who lurks in the shadows, outwitting his opponents through cunning trickery.

skills.name: Forced Game

description.raw: Eryndor invites all non-summoned enemies to play his game. Each enemy independently rolls a die to determine their outcome. Whenever a different ally inflicts a stat reduction effect on an enemy, that enemy permanently gains 1 stack of Woe, stacking up to 3 times. Each stack of Woe reduces the enemy's roll by 1. If the final roll is 3 or lower, the enemy loses the game, surrendering 20% + 2% of their ATK and 15% + 1.5% (SP-based) of their max HP to Eryndor and taking 160% (ATK-based) damage 3 times. Ervndor can claim stats from each enemy up to 3 times. The total ATK and max HP Ervndor gains this wav cannot exceed 100% + 10% (SP-based) of his corresponding stats.

skills.name: Unfurling Blades

description.raw: Eryndor unleashes 9 fan blades to strike non-summoned enemies in order from lowest to highest HP percentage, dealing 70% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage per blade. Each stack of Woe on a target further increases the damage they take from this skill by 10% + 1% (SP-based).

skills.name: Veiled Return

description.raw: Eryndor throws a spinning fan into the area with the most enemies and gains a shield that absorbs 300% (ATK-based) damage. The fan remains in that area for 1.5s, dealing 170% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage 4 times to enemies within 1 tile. Upon the fan's return, Eryndor gains an extra shield equal to 20% + 2% (SP-based) of the actual damage dealt by this skill. Shields granted by this skill last for 8s.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Eryndor gains 10 Haste during battle. When an enemy loses his game, he gains an extra 6 Haste.
active: When an enemy loses his game, he gains an extra 6 Haste.

text: When an enemy loses his game, he gains an extra 7 Haste.
When an enemy loses his game, he gains an extra 8 Haste.

skills.description_lite: Eryndor increases his Haste, with an additional increase when an enemy loses his game.

skills.name: All is Lost

description.raw: When Eryndor uses his Ultimate, if an enemy loses his game, his Ultimate lands 1 extra hit that deals 200% (ATK-based) damage to that enemy. Each subsequent loss by that enemy increases the number of extra hits they take by 1, up to 3 hits.
active: When Eryndor uses his Ultimate, if an enemy loses his game, his Ultimate lands 1 extra hit that deals 200% (ATK-based) damage to that enemy.
Each subsequent loss by that enemy increases the number of extra hits they take by 1, up to 3 hits.

text: Increases the damage dealt by extra hits to 225% (ATK-based).

Once a non-boss enemy has lost Eryndor's game 2 times, they are permanently stripped of all stat buffs for the rest of the battle, and their ATK is further reduced by 15% of Eryndor's ATK, down to a minimum of 20% of the target's initial ATK.
Increases the damage dealt by extra hits to 250% (ATK-based).

skills.description_lite: Enemies who lose Eryndor's game take extra damage multiple times.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: When a battle starts, Eryndor collects 7% of every non-summoned enemy's basic stats as an entry fee. The total amount collected for each stat cannot exceed 35% of Eryndor's corresponding stat.
